text.p: These are the leading stories in the Nambian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The proposed takeover of the Rosh Pinah zinc mine by Australian base metal mining concern Western Metals appears to have fallen through. Iscor Ltd which owns the assets said on Monday that the deal would no longer happen as the circumstances of the parties involved had changed.

- Standard Bank Investment Corp in Namibia has announced an increase of three-quarters of a percent in its prime overdraft rate and an equal increase in its interest rates for saving and fixed deposits.
- A steep increase in fuel prices can be expected at the end of January after the subsidy for the oil industry doubled during the year.
- Around two hundred passengers due to leave Windhoek on a Lufthansa flight on Monday night were angy about the lack of service after their departure was cancelled due to a technical defect.
